note: The repository holds the toolkit's source tree AND the data folders, so a clone works at once. Releases are squashed (one orphan commit per release, force-pushed) so the data never accumulates history, and .gitattributes marks the data folders binary so they never render as diffs. The full-resolution Beinecke scans (data/images) are not shipped; fetch-data --group images downloads them by their IIIF URLs.
